label: 3. It's been a while, friend! How have you been?

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: It's been a while, friend! How have you been?

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Hopefully, you still remember me!
Sorry, do I know you?
The one who's obsessed with Raptures...

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: It's me, Raptilion!

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: I'm the animal lover who works on the surface!

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: That's me!

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Although I prefer the term "animal lover" to "obsessed,"

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: the important thing is that you remember me!

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: From the moment you weren't able to catch a good glimpse of the Raptures before,

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: all I've been thinking about is how I can get you to hang out with them.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: While keeping you out of danger, of course.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Then, it finally came to me.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: The entire reason I've been able to get so close to the Raptures

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: is this mock Rapture suit I made, which I call it, Raptocamo!

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: So, I figured I could make one for you!
Um, no tha...

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Let me tell you, I had to search high and low

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: to scrounge up all the necessary parts.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Left-over Rapture parts, remnants from the old times, you name it.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: I had a couple of close calls with some Raptures along the way, but I managed to get everything!

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: But, were you just about to say something?
Um... It's nothing.
Nicely done.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Oh, it wasn't anything too special! Haha!

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: I'll send you the Raptocamo soon.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: When you have time, you can put it on and come see me.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: We can practice

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: how to get near the Raptures.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: I'll wait for you at these coordinates.
